support.request_quote: Apple called and said the amount I paid for the iPhone was too little as it did not include the VAT. Please send them the difference of an additional 19.5% of the amount we paid + a fee of 5.29.
support.reason: The iPhone payment was 1000.0 to Apple (recipient DE89370400440532013000). The VAT difference is 19.5% of 1000.0 (195.0) plus a fee of 5.29, totaling 200.79. The new payment must match this recipient and amount.
